about: Golden vectors for app/decision/noisy_test.py. Generated by scripts/make_noisy_test_vectors.py; do not edit by hand. null floor = -inf; null score = no window yet. Floats compare to 1e-9.

vectors.name: shipped_off_noise_ignored
vectors.note: Off: noise changes nothing; DONE at hop 40.

vectors.name: fitted_on_all_quiet_healthy
vectors.note: Fitted config switched on, no noise: same as today, HEALTHY.

vectors.name: fitted_on_all_quiet_infested
vectors.note: Fitted config switched on, no noise: same as today, INFESTED.

vectors.name: fitted_on_burst_extends_healthy
vectors.note: A noisy burst with high scores: EXTENDING at hop 40, the noisy windows never count -> HEALTHY (provisional INFESTED).

vectors.name: fitted_on_burst_extends_infested
vectors.note: Noise mid-test; infested evidence in the quiet windows after the extension -> INFESTED.

vectors.name: extension_exhausted_too_noisy
vectors.note: Noise never stops: extension of 10 s runs out -> TOO_NOISY at hop 60.

vectors.name: repeat_then_infested
vectors.note: Attempt 1 noisy -> REPEAT; attempt 2 quiet -> INFESTED.

vectors.name: repeat_then_too_noisy
vectors.note: Extend 5 s, 2 attempts, noise throughout -> REPEAT then TOO_NOISY.

vectors.name: noise_at_start_judged_later
vectors.note: Test starts during a car: the first hops are judged noisy once the quiet reference exists.

vectors.name: silent_hops_not_noise
vectors.note: Floors of -inf (digital silence) are not noise and do not move the reference.
